_contract: Row-input fingerprint S, shared byte for byte by boredom-vessel (src/row-state.ts rowStateFingerprint) and development-vessel's parity twin. Each vector: the row (`row`), the canonical serialization S hashes (`canonical`), and S (`s`, lowercase hex sha256 of canonical's UTF-8 bytes). `same_as` / `differs_from` name another vector S must equal / differ from.

spec.included: status, category (top level, String(x ?? "")); falsifier = String((typeof f === object ? f.class : f) ?? "").toLowerCase() of metadata.falsifier; metadata.evidence_resolve, metadata.verify_shape, metadata.predicate_source (as found, absent → null); edit_site = the first non-blank trimmed string of metadata edit_site, file_path, change_site, path, else a top-level file_path, else ""; parent_gap_id = String(metadata.parent_gap_id ?? row.parent_gap_id ?? ""); failure_lessons = for each metadata.failure_lessons entry that is a non-array object whose String(class ?? "") is not "decomposition_refusal", in array order: [String(class ?? ""), String(reason ?? "").slice(0, 300)] (UTF-16 code units).
spec.metadata: row.classification_metadata if it is a non-array object, else row.metadata if it is a non-array object, else {}.
spec.excluded: summary (a re-emitting detector rewrites it with rolling counts), occurrence_count, example_trace_ids (not in the included list), decomposed_at, decomposition, investigated_at, investigation_declined, every object key ending in _at at any depth (including inside evidence_resolve), decomposition_refusal lessons, every lesson's at.
spec.serialization: JSON with no whitespace; object keys sorted at every depth in ascending UTF-16 code-unit order (JavaScript's default sort; integer-like keys are NOT placed first); keys whose value is undefined omitted and keys ending in _at dropped at every depth; arrays in their own order; each string/number/boolean/null exactly as JSON.stringify writes it alone (non-ASCII as itself, not \u-escaped; a non-finite number is null).
spec.hash: S = lowercase hex sha256 of the canonical string's UTF-8 bytes; logs print S's first 8 hex characters as S=<8 hex>.
